bibl.title: Selling an Inheritance for an Under-age Owner in 7th Century Aphrodite
bibl.seg: Maria Nowak & Brian McGing, Selling an Inheritance for an Under-age Owner in 7th Century Aphrodite.
Pylon. Editions and Studies of Ancient Texts 5 (2024) §1-70, fig.
bibl.note: P. Chester Beatty Library Inv. 1016 02130. Dialysis. Aphrodite, 610-612. - [Acquisition.] - The situation: having reached the legal age, Aurelius Basileios provides a written dialysis to assure the purchaser that there would be no legal claim made against him concerning a property he bought from Basileios as a boy, with his brothers as representatives. - Kollouthos, son of Christophoros - Christophoros, father of Kollouthos. - [Edition and commentary.]
